title: Completed local normal form for invertible Kummer monoid extensions
statement:
Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a nonzero Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $R,Q$ fine saturated monoids [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and $h:R\to Q$ an injective homomorphism such that every $q\in Q$ has a positive multiple in $h(R)$. Assume that $h^{\rm gp}$ is injective with finite cokernel annihilated by a positive integer $N$ invertible in $A$. Let $\alpha:R\to(A,\cdot)$ be a homomorphism, put $G=\alpha^{-1}(A^\times)$ and $S=R_G/G^{\rm gp}$, where $R_G=\{r-g:r\in R,g\in G\}\subset R^{\rm gp}$. Suppose a homomorphism $a:S\to(A,\cdot)$ and a character $\epsilon:R^{\rm gp}\to A^\times$ have been chosen such that $\alpha(r)=\epsilon(r)a(\bar r)$ for every $r\in R_G$, where $\bar r$ denotes its image in $S$ and $\alpha$ is extended to $R_G$ by inverting its units. Assume the maximal-ideal completion $\widehat A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], compatibly with the monomials $a(u)$, has one of the following presentations for some finite $n\ge0$: (a) $k[[S]][[t_1,\ldots,t_n]]$, where $k=A/\mathfrak m$ is a coefficient field; (b) $V[[S]][[t_1,\ldots,t_n]]/(\theta)$, where $V$ is a Cohen ring with residue field $k$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and $\theta\equiv p\pmod{(S\setminus\{0\},t_1,\ldots,t_n)}$, with $p$ the uniformizer of $V$. Here formal monoid rings are completions of $E[S][t]$ at $(\mathfrak m_E,S\setminus\{0\},t)$, and monoid rings have basis $[u]$ and multiplication $[u][v]=[u+v]$.
Put $C=A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[R]}\mathbf Z[Q]$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Let $\mathfrak q$ be any prime of $C$ contracting to $\mathfrak m$, put $B=C_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $F=\{q\in Q:[q]\in B^\times\}$, $T=Q_F/F^{\rm gp}$ with $Q_F=\{q-f:q\in Q,f\in F\}$, and $J=([q]:q\in Q\setminus F)B$. Then there is a nonzero complete regular Noetherian local ring $D$ [def-weil-regular-scheme] with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ and a continuous isomorphism identifying the indicated ideals as follows:
$$ (\widehat B,J\widehat B)\cong (D[[T]],([v]:v\in T\setminus\{0\}))\quad\text{in case (a)},$$
$$ (\widehat B,J\widehat B)\cong (D[[T]]/(\eta),([v]:v\in T\setminus\{0\}))\quad\text{in case (b)},$$
where $\widehat B$ is the maximal-ideal completion, $D[[T]]$ is the completion of $D[T]$ at $(\mathfrak m_D,T\setminus\{0\})$, and the reduction $\overline\eta\in D=D[[T]]/(T\setminus\{0\})$ belongs to $\mathfrak m_D\setminus\mathfrak m_D^2$.

source.place: Expose VI 2.3, printed p.73, completed equal- and mixed-characteristic Kummer chart formulas; arbitrary unit faces and chart twists made explicit as in the existing formal-monoid-extension model.
